findings: asyncio.run() in API mode — _call_api wraps AsyncOpenAI in asyncio.run(); raises RuntimeError if the thread already owns an event loop. Use synchronous OpenAI client or loop.run_until_complete() with loop detection.

Chinese prop names in English prompts — _prop_to_english returns original Chinese when ASCII ratio < 0.4; that string lands in English image-generation prompts. Add a logger.warning or neutral placeholder for untranslatable props.
json_repair not in requirements.txt — used as a silent fallback for truncated LLM JSON; add json-repair as an optional dependency.
Slot-shift migration — ScriptParser (slots 2–8) and ShotPromptBuilder (slots 2–5) changed; old saved workflows silently wire wrong outputs. MIGRATION.md and v2 display names added in fix commit.
environment_3view_prompt pipe format is an implicit contract — the downstream 3-view generator must split on ' | '; document this in the node tooltip or docstring.
API key stored in plaintext workflow JSON — llm_api_key is a plain STRING widget; use os.getenv('AFE_LLM_API_KEY', '') as default to keep keys out of saved files.
